root_cause.text: The function mt7615_mcu_wtbl_sta_add() fails to free a previously allocated skb (sskb) when another allocation or function call (mt76_connac_mcu_alloc_wtbl_req()) fails, leading to a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `dev_kfree_skb(sskb);` inside the error-handling block for the failing call: `if (IS_ERR(wtbl_hdr)) { dev_kfree_skb(sskb); return PTR_ERR(wtbl_hdr); }`.
